gen-dm-serif-text-switzer: Scratch-thin arms on heavy stems: that is bookish DM Serif Text. Switzer holds a tubular sans-serif wire, c tips never touching, while that serif does editorial contrast best.
gen-dm-serif-text-work-sans: Work Sans keeps contemporary c tips apart, joins matching the strokes. And DM Serif Text parks sharp thick-thin over that tube-like sans-serif line without flattening it.
gen-fraunces-fs-epilogue: Dignified Fraunces opens every curve and keeps those thickness shifts fairly mild. Epilogue does unclamped wire plus stubby-ascender lowercase best, while Fraunces holds those bookish openings on the heading.
gen-fraunces-gf-science-gothic: Fraunces opens every curve with only a mild stem-to-arm shift. Science Gothic can drop a point, one bar thickness and letter-at-a-time spacing still holding the column.
gen-irish-grover-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point stays a marker-like sans-serif, gaps distinct, bulky lowercase throughout. And Irish Grover keeps a softer thick-thin, so Sulphur Point can run a column without that organic heading getting in the way.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-stack-sans-headline: Open jaws on every curve mark Mystery Quest at once. Compact ascenders sit over Stack Sans Headline, whose wire-cut strokes keep a deep midzone through copy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sen: Distinctive Unica One keeps one thickness and daylight in every curve. Sen holds the sans-serif constant-weight line, and that shared open, one-thickness build is the lock.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-technor: Bold Gugi nearly matches capitals with lowercase, terminals cut open. Technor glows as neon-tube plain sans beside it, little case difference, so both shout at one thickness.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ysabeau-infant: Red Hat Display draws a marker-width line with daylight inside every curve on that heading line. Constant width plus Ysabeau Infant tongs is what locks them.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi stays clean copy, an e opening rightward, outsized lowercase throughout. Wallpoet wants a few huge words, unobstructed bends and paper showing between letters, not a full heading column.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-ubuntu-sans: Stretched tracking, no contrast: Warnes tapers before letters touch. Ubuntu Sans then pipes copper-tube sans-serif bowls under that display shout, unfinished loops keeping the column moving.
gen-tourney-fs-technor: Tourney cuts every stroke at one width, tracking stretched wide. Tourney and Technor both shout in one-width geometry, bulky small letters over neon-tube bowls on the sheet.
gen-megrim-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed comes through clean, lowercase nearly matching the capitals, stencil-cut and left open. Megrim sits over that plain sans without a fight at all.
gen-almendra-display-work-sans: Work Sans stays contemporary under Almendra Display, c tips apart and joins matching the strokes on this sans-serif line. A slightly reduced heading still reads; a larger body also holds.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-tasa-orbiter: Oswald knits confident rows tight, a strong display line over TASA Orbiter and its unclogged counters below. The heading wants a few huge words, nothing else.
